Case reference: 2021022793.CaseDesc: On May 30, 2021, Thomas Grise was last seen at a family residence in Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation, Alberta.

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.

Teeth: Visible Decay, Missing an upper front tooth on the left side prior to death. The upper front tooth on the right side was angled.
Deformity: Left Knee, Osgoode-Schlatter's disease - bony bump on shin below knee

Case reference: 2022032399.CaseDesc: On May 25, 2022, partial skeletal remains of this man were found in a forested area near Salmon Arm, British Columbia. He had a severe fracture to his right lower leg during life, which required surgical intervention. He likely died many months to years before his remains were found.

Foreign Object: Right Leg, fracture to right tibia with surgical implant

Case reference: 2014001558.CaseDesc: Louis Cochrane was reported missing when his family became concerned about his absence as he had a history of memory loss and a history of running into the bush and/or wandering off. An intensive search of the land proved unsuccessful. A set of footprints were found leading into the water of the river and an intensive operation involving the drilling of 10 holes through the ice in the area failed to yield any evidence. Louis' whereabouts remain unknown.

Teeth: 2 molars absent on upper right side
Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Arm, Left arm in cast

Case reference: 2020006473.CaseDesc: On April 22, 1967, at approximately 6:00pm, Roy Debone was last seen by his landlord in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 1987203340.CaseDesc: Joanne Pedersen went missing on February 19, 1983, near her home at Vedder Crossing (Chilliwack). She was last seen with an adult male at a telephone booth.

Case reference: 2014006380.CaseDesc: Dean Kelly Morrison was last seen October 23, 2013, after being dismissed from his job. His vehicle was left abandoned on a ranch.

Case reference: 2015036270.CaseDesc: Brian Franko was last seen on July 10, 2015, walking away from the Saskatchewan Hospital in North Battleford.  He did not appear to be in a good frame of mind, and his demeanour suggested that he was feeling despondent.  Brian was walking towards the South Saskatchewan River when he was last seen.  Extensive searches were conducted, but unfortunately these were unsuccessful.

Case reference: 2013000018.CaseDesc: On November 17th, 2010, Varaporn Toassami left Canada with her daughter, Chonticha Galamae Ellefson-Toassami in contravention of a family Court Order.  They travelled to Thailand, where it is believed they still are today.  Varaporn Toassami has been charged with child abduction under Section 282 of the Criminal Code.  There is a warrant for her arrest.

Case reference: 2013000041.CaseDesc: David Luborsky was reported missing on the 4th of November 2010. David was last seen leaving the Parklane Residence which is situated at 1095 Merivale Road, in the City of Ottawa.

Tattoo: Right Upper Arm, Irishman holding a beer
Right Side Of Neck, Clover leaf

Case reference: 2018063463.CaseDesc: During the last week of November in 1992, Slavko Orasnin was seen for the last time by his landlord in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005809.CaseDesc: On June 8, 2012, Martha Kelly was last seen walking near her residence in Perth-Andover, New-Brunswick. Martha suffered a brain injury in the past, leaving her at times with short term memory problems. Martha has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002591.CaseDesc: Richard Kelly Little went missing on May 23, 1997. Richard was last seen at residence in Port Coquitlam. Richard was also known to be transgender.

Case reference: 2008015199.CaseDesc: On September 28, 1978, Alison Mary Thomas was visiting her boyfriend in Toronto Ontario. Shortly after midnight she left his residence walking towards Yonge Street, Toronto. Alison Thomas had indicated that she was going to get a taxi cab to take her to her residence, but she never arrived. An extensive investigation was conducted by the Toronto Police Service, but to this day, Alison Thomas has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2020028363.CaseDesc: On July 20, 2020, around 9:00 a.m., Sumira Rashid was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec when she left her family home. Sumira left home with a sports bag under the pretext of going shopping but she never returned and has not been seen since. An investigation concluded that Sumira later took a flight to Los Angeles, California.

Case reference: 2014004345.CaseDesc: Thomas Brock was reported missing in September 1999 after family and friends became concerned as they had not had contact with him since June 2009. Thomas was last seen in the Goose Lake and Barrhead regions of Alberta.

Case reference: 2020040144.CaseDesc: On May 28, 1950, Mabel Crumback was seen for the last time at approximately 12:30 am at her home located in Toronto, Ontario. Mabel had been babysitting her younger brother while her family was out of town. The following morning, she was gone.

Case reference: 2014004010.CaseDesc: On September 16, 1993, Howard Metacat was last seen in Indian Cabins, Alberta. Howard was hunting alone along the Hay River, 6 miles north of Indian Cabins and wandered away from his campsite in the early morning hours of September 17, 1993.

Scar: Neck, 2 inches on the right side

Case reference: 2023005753.CaseDesc: On January 1,1970, Anne Moran was last seen by her husband in their residence in Toronto, Ontario.  It was believed by her family that her husband reported her missing however no report can be located.  Her husband has since passed away.

Case reference: 2014005786.CaseDesc: Giuseppe Renda was last seen on May 4, 2012, at approximately 12:30 p.m., on Saint-Viateur Street West in the Plateau Mont-Royal borough of Montreal, Quebec. Giuseppe lived in the Westmount District, and was a discreet man who did not leave his home often.

Case reference: 2006007499.CaseDesc: David Goetz and Lucas Zenger were last seen on August 23, 1992, in the Owen Sound area. They went for a canoe ride.  They travelled down the shoreline along Kepple Township, towards Big Bay. The canoe was located approximately 1.5 miles off Cape Commodore.

Case reference: 2013000079.CaseDesc: Gilles Chiasson has been missing from Montreal, Quebec since April 18, 1995. Gilles took a taxi after a night out in a bar and was never seen again.

Case reference: 2014002585.CaseDesc: Mario Levasseur was last seen leaving the family home on December 1, 1983, in Levis, Quebec.

Case reference: 2022054292.CaseDesc: Steven Blanchette Rochefort was reported missing on October 26, 2022. The last footprint of life for Steven  was on July 11, 2022, in Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2023037557.CaseDesc: On July 13, 2023, Travis McDuffie was seen for the last time in Calgary, Alberta.  Reports have been received of possible sightings of Travis at several businesses located in the 3200 to 5100 blocks of 17 Avenue S.E., Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2006020299.CaseDesc: Mary Ann Copeman was last seen on September 5, 1993 when she left to go on a recreational walk. Mary Ann was known to have mental health issues and may have been in a confused state. She was walking in the vicinity of Fifth Street in Balmertown, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004389.CaseDesc: On October 23, 2003, Bertha Melvin, a resident of a group home, left a note saying she was going to hospital. However, she failed to attend.  Bertha is described as very introverted and may have been frequenting urban areas and the Waterways neighbourhood in Fort McMurray, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014004464.CaseDesc: Singh Sukmwinder Lebahna was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on February 26, 2004. Singh Sukmwinder left the apartment he was sharing with a friend, taking all his personal belongings, stating he wanted to live in Vancouver, British Columbia. Singh Sukmwinder is originally from India.

Case reference: 2014004835.CaseDesc: Ashleigh Pettman was last seen on June 3 2005 in the downtown area of Kelowna, British Columbia. She had moved to Kelowna from Grand Prairie, Alberta in March 2005 to live with her grandmother. In May 2005, Ashleigh gathered her belongings and moved out of her grandmother's residence to an unknown location.

Case reference: 2006022399.CaseDesc: Jocelyn "Josh" Blais was last seen in a bait shop in Ignace, Ontario. He and a friend were headed to Cecil Lake (24 kilometres north of Ignace and 1 kilometre east off Hwy. 599) for a day of fishing. His overturned boat was later discovered.

Case reference: 2017045193.CaseDesc: Walter Allan departed from his residence in Wiarton, Ontario on July 18, 2017, to attend a coin collecting conference in Montreal, Quebec.  Walter did not attend the conference and was last seen on July 21, 2017, on security footage near Iberville, Quebec. Walter's vehicle was later located on August 24 2017 in a field near Saint-Barthelemy, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014001247.CaseDesc: On July 3, 1989, Henry and his brother, William Gerbrand, were fishing in a canoe on Codette Lake near Nipawin, Saskatchewan. At approximately 8:00 p.m., boaters reported hearing calls for help. It is suspected that both men drowned; despite extensive efforts, they were not located by divers.

Case reference: 2015041172.CaseDesc: Helen Leyden was last in communication with her family between 1968 and 1972. At that time, she was residing in Edmonton, Alberta, but there is a possibility that she relocated to Vancouver, British Columbia, during that period.

Case reference: 2014003491.CaseDesc: On June 12th, 1981, Gordon Westover was seen at a local beer garden in Fort St John, BC at approximately 11:00 PM. Mr. Westover left the gathering in an unknown direction and has not been seen or heard from since. Mr. Westover has a mild mental disability and has been known to impersonate professional people such as police, firefighters, military and doctors. Mr. Westover told several people at the party that he was going to join the military, but no records show Mr. Westover was ever recruited. Mr. Westover has not been seen or heard from.

Case reference: 2026007466.CaseDesc: On April 3, 1994 Heidi Allen was last seen at the D & W Convenience Store located at the intersection of State Routes 104 and 104B in Oswego County, Town of New Haven, New York, USA.  Heidi’s personal belongings were left behind and her vehicle was abandoned in the parking lot.

Glasses: Wears either glasses or contact lenses
Jewelry: Gold, 18" gold chain with a heart and diamond charm
Sweater: Grey, Sweatshirt, Plaid pattern with "SU" Logo on the front

Case reference: 2010000599.CaseDesc: Bradley Allan Taylor was on his way home to Enfield, Nova Scotia from London, Ontario. He spent the night in Brockville, Ontario at the Travelodge Motel.  On January 10, 2009, he left the motel in the morning and later that day police found his car abandoned near a railway crossing in Roussillon, Quebec. Many of his personal belongings were found in the car. Police searched the area but Bradley was not located.

Hair: Brown, Long, Straight, Beard, Moustache, Sideburns

Case reference: 2014001485.CaseDesc: On July 31, 1981, Mohamad Daher was seen for the last time as he left his residence, in the Anjou district in Montreal, Quebec, for a business meeting. His vehicle was found at Le Boulevard Shopping Centre in the Saint-Leonard neighbourhood. Mohamad has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2024055153.CaseDesc: Edmund Zielinski last spoke to his family on July 29 2024 and is believed to be in the area of Genesse County, NY, USA. Edmund is known to have suffered from paranoia and it is possible that he may have made his way to the gorge area of Niagara Falls.

Scar: Neck, On the neck from spinal surgery

Case reference: 2014001370.CaseDesc: Irene Godreau was reported missing on August 3, 2002 from the nursing home where she resided in Grand Falls, New Brunswick. Irene, who was 78 years old when she went missing, was last seen on the front porch of the nursing home at roughly 2:30 p.m. on August 3, 2002 and was not seen again. Irene has difficulty walking, which raised concerns for her safety and ability to travel far on her own. A thorough search of the surrounding area was performed but those efforts yielded no trace of her.

Case reference: 2013000010.CaseDesc: Jaime Wyatt was reported missing to the St-John's RCMP by family members that he had not been seen since November 12th, 1996. Jaime was a resident of Newfoundland and left the province in September 1996 to seek employment in Nova Scotia. The investigation revealed that Jaime stayed at the Twin Elms Motel on Inglis Street in Halifax, Nova Scotia and he was last seen there on November 16th, 1996. On the evening of November 16th, 1996, Jaime informed the staff at Twin Elms that he was going to be picked up to go to a dinner party that evening.  Jaime was never heard from or seen since that day and foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2020008557.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1984, at approximately 10:00 am, Rodolf Scoulde was last seen leaving his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Rodolf was on his way to a nearby store.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Sword and heart with the word "COCO"

Case reference: 2012020072.CaseDesc: Claudette Osborne (born Tyo) was last seen leaving the Lincoln Motor Hotel on McPhillips Street in Winnipeg, Manitoba on the morning of 25 July 2008.

Hair: Brown, Blonde, Straight, Long, Bottom 12" dyed blonde

Case reference: 2020008388.CaseDesc: On December 10, 1982, David Templar was seen for the last time when he was picked up by his father for a visitation. David was to be returned home to his mother on December 12, but never returned. It is believed that his father may have brought him to India.

Coat: Other, Parka; Khaki coloured with white fur trim on hood

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2016012267.CaseDesc: On February 28, 2016, Lorlene Bone was last seen at a friend’s residence on the Shoal River Indian Reserve in Manitoba. Lorlene is a mother of four and it is out of character for her not to contact her family.

Tattoo: Left Side Of Neck, Three hearts

Case reference: 2014040055.CaseDesc: Clinton Lemay was last observed on Friday October 31, 2014, leaving his friends residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time Clinton was feeling despondent.

Shirt: Blue, Black, Plaid, long sleeved button up
Scar: Left Hand, 2" on the back of the hand
Right Hand, Small, on the back of the hand.
Tattoo: Left Forearm, Text " Clint Loves AR, Audrey"

Case reference: 2014004318.CaseDesc: On the morning of April 13, 2001, Céline Goyette was dropped off at her husband Richard Gleeson's residence, located on Forestwood Street in Rosemère, Quebec. Since that time, she has not been seen and has not given any more news to her relatives. Moreover, her spouse Richard Gleeson has also disappeared since that time.

Case reference: 2020020791.CaseDesc: On May 12, 2020, David was supposed to cross into Tucson, Arizona from Nogales, Mexico. Unfortunately, he has not been heard from since. Last contact was made around midnight between May 12 and 13, 2020.

Scar: Upper Back, Stab wound scar (51 mm)

Case reference: 2014004580.CaseDesc: On the morning of July 23, 1991, a group of 8 individuals left Igloolik, Nunavut and headed to Hall Beach, Nunavut.  The group travelled using a 24 foot freighter canoe powered by a 30 hp outboard motor.  It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2014004850.CaseDesc: On November 26, 2006, Mario Julien was seen for the last time when he left his home in Lévis, Quebec aboard a taxi. The taxi transported him just to the roundabout in the Québec Bridge, in Quebec City, Quebec.

Case reference: 2015011654.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1994, a baby was found in the Rivière des Prairies between the island of Montréal and the Visitation park Island in the Ahuntsic neighborhood. The body was naked and had a plastic bag wrapped around the wrist. According to experts the body would have been in the water since the fall.

Case reference: 2014004183.CaseDesc: Virginia Sampare was last seen on October 14, 1971. Ms. Sampare was despondent over the death of her boyfriend. Ms. Sampare left the residence in the evening of that date and was not seen again.

Shirt: Cotton, Short sleeve navy blue shirt

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2021009119.CaseDesc: On March 8, 2021, Amber Ellis was reported missing by her mother. During the time of her disappearance, Amber was leading a high-risk lifestyle.

Scar: Left Thigh, Scar from a stab wound

Case reference: 2014001532.CaseDesc: Gavin Edkins was last observed departing the Fort McMurray International Airport in Alberta on May 19, 1996, piloting a red and white Cessna aircraft bound for Red Deer, Alberta. The plane did not make it to its intended destination. Gavin and the plane haven't been located.

Coat: Leather, Black, With red liner - size 38
Jewelry: Metal, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Watch, "Timex" brand
Gold, Gold, Chain, With float plane
Gold, Gold, Ring, On left pinky finger

Case reference: 2016061231.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1968, an unidentified male was found hanging in a hotel room. He had checked in under the name Henry Drendorf. No identification was found. This individual was found with several bags of architectural books.

Case reference: 2014004372.CaseDesc: Patrick-Jean De Loppinot was last seen on September 11, 2003, at a friend's residence in Laval, Quebec. Patrick-Jean was supposed to go home that evening but never arrived. He was driving a black 1990 Volkswagen Jetta registered in Québec. At the time of his disappearance, Patrick-Jean lived with family in Longueuil, Quebec.

Case reference: 2025011809.CaseDesc: Suzanne Frech was seen on March 11, 2025, entering the waterway between Lake Gibson and Lake Moodie in the area of the DeCew House Heritage Park near Decew Road in St. Catharines, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance, Suzanne was feeling despondent.

Case reference: 2016068711.CaseDesc: On September 30, 1969, an unidentified male was found 0.8 kilometres west of Sioux Lookout. His death appears to be self-inflicted

Case reference: 2014004763.CaseDesc: On October 28, 2005, Leslie Thompson was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Leslie is known as a gambler and frequents bars.

Case reference: 2020007351.CaseDesc: On October 8, 1981, at approximately 3:00pm, Maria Cowan was last seen as she left her home with a friend to go shopping in Toronto, Ontario.

Coat: Leather, Brown, Fur on collar and sleeves

Case reference: 2021047780.CaseDesc: Vincent McLean was last seen on October 1, 2021, at a rural property where he resided in Two Hills County, Alberta. There has been no activity from him since that date.

Case reference: 2014004607.CaseDesc: George Robichaud was last seen by his roommate on March 15, 2005, at their home in Moncton, New Brunswick. George was suffering from mental health issues at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2025015368.CaseDesc: On July 30, 1966, the body of a burned man was found north of 18th street in Val-d'Or, Abitibi, Quebec.  A lighter was found near the body and a metal belt buckle was associated with the body.

Leggings: Lighter, found next to belt buckle

Case reference: 2014005268.CaseDesc: On 26 May 2009, Harold Dorion was reported missing to the Nelson House RCMP (Nisichawayasihk Cree Nation) in Manitoba. Investigations later established that he was last seen in the last week of July 2007. There have been no sightings or contact with Harold since that time. His whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2012020176.CaseDesc: This adult male was found in Vancouver rooming house.

Case reference: 2014002651.CaseDesc: Mabel Leo was last seen leaving a party near Nairn Falls, Pemberton, BC, in 1969, and has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014004857.CaseDesc: On September 21, 1992, David Neufeld, Peter Bentzen and Kenneth Vaughan were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. The three men had been associating with each other as “runners” in order to smuggle cigarettes into Canada from the United States by means of a boat. David’s vehicle and boat trailer were located at Ashbridges Bay, Toronto. The aging boat that was borrowed from a friend has never been recovered and the three men have not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2016052152.CaseDesc: On September 13, 2016 at approximately 9:30 p.m., John Casey was seen for the last time aboard a cruise vessel in transit between Cap-aux-Meules and Havre Saint-Pierre, Quebec. John has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2023044188.CaseDesc: On August 15, 2023, Kevin Evoy was last seen leaving the Giant Tiger store in Clarence-Rockland, Ontario. He has epilepsy, no cell phone, no social media, and no other form of communication. Since Kevin rarely leaves the home, his family is concerned that he may have suffered a medical issue.

Shirt: Blue, White, T-Shirt, Text "ROYALE" on the chest
Tattoo: Right Forearm, Very faded peacock tattoo

Case reference: 2013000133.CaseDesc: On July 14, 2013, Prince Edward OPP (Picton) were advised of a 30 ft sailboat that had run aground on the shores at Point Petre (Lake Ontario). It was determined that the sailboat was from Rochester, New York and had left the Chimney Bluff State Park Marina (New York) on July 13,  2013 in the morning. Based on GPS tracks the investigators suspect that Scott French went overboard in American waters, and the boat drifted into Canadian Waters.

Hair: Brown, Brush Cut, Balding at the front
Shoes: Leather, White, New Balance, Running shoe

Case reference: 2014005121.CaseDesc: On May 10, 2008, Marie Claude Chrétien spent part of the evening at home building a campfire with neighbours in Cantley, Quebec. She was last seen by her next-door neighbour at around 11:30 p.m. No one has had any contact with her since and Marie Claude left no message or clue as to her whereabouts.

Teeth: False, Upper dental prosthetic and natural lower teeth

Case reference: 2014003913.CaseDesc: Martin Maier was last seen on May 4, 1973, leaving the local hotel in Prelate, Saskatchewan at approximately 1:00 a.m. He was driving a red 1971 Chevrolet half-ton pick-up Saskatchewan license F133013 with a white camper on the cargo box.  Extensive searches have been conducted, however neither Martin or his vehicle have been located.

Sweater: Wool, Other, Siwash brand with a fish design, knitted

When her husband returned that day, around 2:30 p.m., there was nobody home and the back door was unlocked.  Jian Ping Li's car was still at the residence, however she left without her purse, wallet, credit card, cell phone, money, as well as the diaper bag, the stroller and the car seat for the baby.

Case reference: 2014004330.CaseDesc: On December 27, 2002, at approximately 9 a.m., Jaroslav "Joe" Heindl was last seen by the Lakeshore IGA Food Store in Regina, Saskatchewan. He was known to collect discarded items from around stores and other locations, and his vehicle was located nearby. Despite extensive searches and investigations, he has not been located.

Case reference: 2006023199.CaseDesc: Kenneth Churney was last seen in March of 1997. He was on a snowmobile travelling northbound toward the trail system head at the rear of Pine Crescent. He never returned from snowmobiling and may have been feeling despondent.

Deformity: Left Ring Finger, 0.5 of an inch shorter

Case reference: 2006019499.CaseDesc: David Block was reported missing from Swastika, Ontario. He had been seen in Newfoundland in 1994.  David suffered from mental health issues that could bring him to the attention of authorities. He was last seen in Washington D.C., U.S.A, on May 1, 1995.

Case reference: 2014003751.CaseDesc: Lucien Sale was last seen driving his truck in Chisholm, Alberta on September 21, 1991. On September 26, 1991, his truck was located abandoned on a logging road off into the bush.

Case reference: 2022041871.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1994, Johnny Baker was seen for the last time at his residence in Borger Texas, USA.

Case reference: 2018040311.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2003, Karanjeet Singh was seen for the last time as he left with some of his personal belongings to go visit a friend in Toronto, Ontario. Karanjeet was visiting Toronto from India and was due to return on May 24.

Case reference: 2014004308.CaseDesc: Joseph Laboucan was last seen in Peace River, Alberta, on or around August 10, 1998. He lived on the streets in Peace River and Little Buffalo, Alberta. He made occasional trips around the area as far as Edmonton.

Case reference: 2018062802.CaseDesc: On August 27, 2000, at approximately 11:00 a.m., Yao Lin was seen for the last time at his residence in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002843.CaseDesc: A party of 6 men departed Churchill, Manitoba, on a fishing trip traveling in three canoes. On June 20, 1967, two of the three canoes became stranded on mud flats at a point where the Hayes and Nelson Rivers empty into the Hudson Bay. The men made camp for the night and then the following day Kurt Hild, Ronald Davidson and James Cochrane all attempted to retrieve the stranded canoes. On return to the camp the men were confronted with high winds and freezing rain which forced them out of sight. None of the remains of the men have been recovered. Foul play is not suspected in the matter.

Case reference: 2014005970.CaseDesc: Gary Forster was last seen on January 13, 2013, in Lachute, Québec. His car was found in Montréal, Québec.

Case reference: 2024006147.CaseDesc: On November 22,1965 Fred Bullas’ vehicle was located in the middle of the Rainbow Bridge in Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005066.CaseDesc: James Douglas Turnball or Turnbull was last seen on the MV Princess of Vancouver vessel commuting from Nanaimo to Vancouver in the waters of the Howe Sound in 1966. Bowen Island RCMP are seeking any next of kin or close relations for the missing male.

Jewelry: Gold, Yellow, Black, black diamond ring
Gold, Yellow, Brown, Timex watch with leather strap

Case reference: 2019065945.CaseDesc: On November 13, 2019, at approximately 7:00 p.m., Shane Kowerko was seen for the last time as he left a friend’s residence in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Shane did not tell his friend where he was going, and left his winter jacket there.

Tattoo: Right Forearm, Girl holding baseball bat
Right Side Of Neck, Jiminy Cricket
Right Forearm, Chinese writing 5 characters (woman, word, name)

Case reference: 2017044551.CaseDesc: On August 4, 2017, at approximately 1:00pm, Mark Trizanto was last seen near Roncesvalles Avenue and the Queensway in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2025067893.CaseDesc: The skeletonised remains of this young adult male were discovered in a ravine in Burnaby, British Columbia, on October 15, 2025. It is likely that he was missing for up to 18 months prior to being found, and he had sustained an injury to his right foot, which had become infected.

Case reference: 2014003363.CaseDesc: At 2:00 a.m., on April 21, 1992, Hilda Beaudoin and her brother left the Beagle Lounge in Mary's Harbour, Newfoundland Labrador. They embarked on a single snowmobile to ride across the sea ice near coastal waters in efforts to return to St. Lewis, Newfoundland and Labrador. Neither Hilda or her brother arrived at their destination. Snowmobile tracks were discovered leading into open water near St. Lewis where the snowmobile and Hilda's brother's body were later recovered from the ocean waters.

Case reference: 2014004699.CaseDesc: On October 4, 2005, Veeravi Jeya Eskimuttu "VJ" was last seen leaving his place of employment in Saint John, New Brunswick. Veeravi is known to be a transient individual who has previously resided in Cornwall and Toronto, Ontario, as well as Montreal, Quebec, and Halifax, Nova Scotia.

Case reference: 2014005537.CaseDesc: Kerry Klyne was last seen working at the Dakota Hotel in Winnipeg, Manitoba.  Kerry made a withdrawal from his Peace Hills Trust account on November 15, 2010 and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Tattoo: Right Shoulder, Tribal art/Band around biceps

Case reference: 2014002505.CaseDesc: On January 27, 1988, Lisa Somerton was seen for the last time outside of her residence located at 1220 Merivale Road in Ottawa, Ontario. She was observed approaching a black sports car with two people inside.

Case reference: 1994001800.CaseDesc: On the evening of August 5, 1989, Casey Bohun was seen for the last time by her mother when she was put to bed in her home in Delta, British Columbia. Prior to her disappearance, Casey and her family had recently moved to this area, and she was not familiar with the neighbourhood. Today, Casey may not realize that she was abducted as a child.

Case reference: 2014006285.CaseDesc: Philippe Guerin was reported missing from the North Bay Psychiatric Hospital on June 12, 1966. He is paralyzed on the left side as a result of having Polio at 10 years of age. He is missing his upper teeth.

Case reference: 2019009625.CaseDesc: On August 12, 2018, Nikhil Arun was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016066833.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1982, an unidentified male was discovered in the Detroit River, near Fighting Island. His post-mortem length was estimated as being between 5'6"-5'8",  however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. It is estimated he was in the water for no more than 6 months.

Jacket: Parka or hooded jacket, which had both a zipper and snap fasteners

Case reference: 2014005187.CaseDesc: In the afternoon of December 29, 1960, Helga Kaserer was seen for the last time in the area of Harvard Avenue and Roncesvalles Avenue in Toronto, Ontario.
